answer: Bonded attestation is a concrete defense: each identity escrows service credit before its claims count. Peers may challenge a claim by staking half that bond: a false claim is slashed to the challenger, a true one costs the challenger its stake. A sybil farm cannot buy credibility: every alias needs fresh capital, each exposure pays challengers more than it earned, so farms drain faster than they grow. One exposure sends an echo across the operator's aliases. Trust comes from a knoll of settled disputes, not age. Stakes are copper credits, heavy enough to make fabrication pricey.
